name: RefinedNowPlaying
author: MiHN, solstice23, long45343 lineage (see source)
description: 重新设计的正在播放页面和歌词（3.x 续作 RefinedNowPlayingNext 3.0.2）

source.why: The 2.19.5 bundle targets the NetEase Cloud Music 2.x DOM, which no longer exists in 3.1.41: #main-player, .m-player, .g-single, .n-single, .cdimg, .btnp, .brt, .cvr.j-curr, .playfrom and #page_pc_userfm_songplay all occur ZERO times in web.pack 477f8a2 (verified). This successor is the same lineage, declares ncm3-compatible: true, requires ncm > 3.1.11, and carries a 3.1.11+ specific hijack.
source.slug_note: published as slug RefinedNowPlayingNext; pinned to RefinedNowPlaying here so LyricBar's requirements/loadAfter and the user-facing name stay stable. The bundle itself probes only loadedPlugins.{LibFrontendPlay,MaterialYouTheme,RoundCornerNCM}, never its own slug, so this rename is safe.

hijack_note: builtin:redux-dispatch-hook is the successor's OWN 3.1.11+ mechanism (fragment `"sagaEffects.put"),`,
verified to occur exactly once in web.pack 477f8a2, in vendors~app~subApp.chunk). Upstream
expressed it as a response-body rewrite of orpheus://orpheus/pub/hybrid/vendors; the loader
applies it at module-factory level instead (docs/11).
builtin:lyrics-hook additionally makes the client's lyric pipeline call window.onProcessLyrics,
which this bundle still defines (it keeps the lyrics-updated / window.currentLyrics contract that
The successor's own >= 2.10.4 entry targeting orpheus://orpheus/pub/core is dropped on purpose:
that resource does not exist in 3.1.41, so it can only ever be a reported miss.

legacy_hijacks.note: upstream entries kept for provenance; see manifest.upstream.json
